column1: # Stage B of the refactor program (#2062): where each item of src/widgets/search.rs goes.
# One row per item, in file order. pr 0 means the item stays in search.rs; the others
# move to src/widgets/search/<file>.rs in that PR. kind, impl and name are as
# `scripts/move_items.py --target search --check` after adding an item to search.rs.
# search.rs keeps the types its parts share: a hit, the search options, the panel and
# its fields, the toggles, and the panel's constructor.
